packageRules.description: go.yaml.in/yaml/v4 is a release candidate, so updates within the v4 pre-release track are expected rather than exceptional. It is also the encoder image-factory computes schematic IDs with, so it stays in step with upstream rather than moving to another library; TestUpstreamParity is what catches the two diverging.
Everything else non-major in one PR; CI gates it.
Go itself moves via the go directive in go.mod, which setup-go reads; treat it as a deliberate choice rather than an automatic bump.
